title: Deploying a 1-Bit Bonsai-27B Model with PrismML llama.cpp and OpenAI-Compatible Local Inference Workflows
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: In this tutorial, we deploy the 1-bit Bonsai-27B language model using the PrismML fork of llama.cpp, which provides the specialized CUDA kernels required to decode the model’s Q1_0...
body: This guide details the process of deploying the ultra-low-bit Bonsai-27B language model using a specialized CUDA-enabled llama.cpp fork by PrismML. The deployment features an OpenAI-compatible local API server, custom key-value cache optimizations, and benchmark scripts for high-throughput local inference. By packing weights into 1.125-bit representations, the model fits comfortably inside consumer GPU memory, showing the viability of highly quantized local model serving. Developers can run this highly optimized pipeline locally on standard laptops or entry-level cloud instances with minimal setup overhead.
